title: The Last Days of Pompeii
author: Lytton, Edward Bulwer Lytton, Baron
description: "The Last Days of Pompeii" by Baron Edward Bulwer Lytton Lytton is a novel written in 1834.
longDescription: Set in first-century Pompeii, it follows Athenian nobleman Glaucus and his love for the beautiful Ione, threatened by the malevolent Egyptian sorcerer Arbaces. As Arbaces schemes to destroy their happiness through murder and deception, Mount Vesuvius rumbles ominously above.

authorInfo.bio: Lytton, Edward Bulwer Lytton, Baron (1803–1873) is the author of The Last Days of Pompeii. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
